title: Docker
simpleMetaphor: Packages your app and dependencies into a container so it runs identically anywhere.
technicalExplanation: Containerization platform isolating software in lightweight virtualized units.

title: Kubernetes
simpleMetaphor: An automated fleet manager for orchestrating hundreds of Docker containers.
technicalExplanation: Container orchestration system for automating application deployment, scaling, and management.

title: AWS (S3, Lambda)
simpleMetaphor: Amazon's massive cloud infrastructure for file storage, serverless functions, and hosting.
technicalExplanation: Industry-leading cloud platform providing object storage (S3), serverless compute (Lambda), and infrastructure.

title: Vercel
simpleMetaphor: Instant Git-driven hosting platform optimized for modern frontend frameworks.
technicalExplanation: Cloud platform for static sites and serverless functions with seamless GitHub deployment integration.

title: Cloudflare Workers
simpleMetaphor: Runs serverless JavaScript code directly at edge locations closest to your users.
technicalExplanation: Edge computing platform running serverless code globally on Cloudflare's CDN network.

title: Nginx
simpleMetaphor: High-speed web server and traffic cop directing incoming requests to backends.
technicalExplanation: HTTP web server, reverse proxy, load balancer, and HTTP cache.

title: CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
simpleMetaphor: Automates testing, building, and deploying code every time you make a git push.
technicalExplanation: Automated workflow engine directly integrated into GitHub repositories for continuous deployment.
